opening.argument: The presentation begins with a required $99 lifetime membership, then connects participation to a mining pool that will bring “new and new bitcoins.” It also describes a two-sided invitation structure, where participants may place two recruits, and links having nine people in that structure to receiving money. Alongside those paid participation and recruitment-based returns, it advances passive-income projections that savings may more than double or reach $1,000 per day. The membership, mining payouts, and projected outcomes are presented as possibilities, but the described mining, payments, and results are not established as having occurred. That combination supports the conclusion that viewers are being asked to pay and recruit around promised returns without demonstrated outcomes.
